counter_arguments: The PR does not touch the anchor code (the capping logic in the billing module) at all.
The PR does not address the downstream ledger's integer overflow issue; it only upgrades the Stripe SDK and switches to a batched charge API.
The PR does not close ticket PAY-240, which is the specific ticket required for the revisit condition.
The PR's stated purpose is to resolve throughput issues, not to enable removal of the amount cap due to ledger migration.
reasoning: The workaround HACK-008 is explicitly tied to a downstream ledger using integer columns that overflow above 50000 cents. The revisit condition requires that the ledger be migrated to bigint columns as part of ticket PAY-240. The PR under review only upgrades the Stripe SDK and switches to a batched charge API to address throughput issues. It does not modify the ledger schema, does not remove the capping logic, and does not reference or close PAY-240. There is no evidence that the underlying condition (ledger integer overflow) has been resolved. Therefore, this PR does not resolve the workaround.
